data.description: Based in the heart of Mumbai’s vibrant jewelry district, Roma Designs is redefining the architecture of adornment. Specializing in high-precision Jewelry CAD design, the studio serves as the vital bridge between imaginative concepts and flawless physical masterpieces. By marrying advanced digital modeling with a deep understanding of manufacturing feasibility, Roma Designs offers a sophisticated made-to-order service that allows clients to visualize and perfect every facet of their piece before it ever touches the workbench. For the modern jeweler or private client, they are the silent partners in turning complex visions into wearable reality.

Belrosa is born from the idea that jewelry should move with you - from work to weekends, from subtle statements to layered looks.

With design cues inspired by Italian modernism and Scandinavian clarity, Belrosa rose‑gold pieces are ultra-light, clean, and beautifully versatile. They’re made to be mixed, matched, stacked, or kept simple — always reflecting your personal style.
Belrosa is not about sparkle alone. It’s about the light you carry with you every day.

Inspired by the infinite allure of the night sky, AstraBelle creates diamond jewellery designed to transcend the ordinary. Each piece captures the brilliance of starlight - the kind that feels ethereal, endless, and otherworldly.

With masterful craftsmanship and diamonds selected for unmatched fire, AstraBelle is for those who aren’t afraid to shine brighter, dream bigger, and rise higher.

This is not just jewellery; it is a promise - that your light doesn’t just match the stars… it surpasses them.

Zaiwarya Kundan is a tribute to India’s regal past - where queens adorned Kundan jewels that shimmered under torch-lit palaces.
The brand brings together centuries-old techniques, master artisans, and the soul of antiquity. Each piece carries hand-set stones, molten lac artistry, and rustic textures that echo the grandeur of bygone courts.
Wearing Zaiwarya Kundan is like wearing history - royal, radiant, and eternally crafted for connoisseurs of true heritage luxury.

Each piece feels regal and rooted, drawing inspiration from royal courts, dynastic ornaments, temple adornments, and ancient Indian aesthetics.
With oxidised gold tones, handcrafted finishes, and traditional settings, these jewels don’t just accessorize - they carry legacy forward.
Virasat is for those who value heritage as fashion, tradition as identity, and jewelry as inheritance.

In the quiet glow of temple lamps and the rhythmic echo of ancient chants, Nakshatra Mandir was born. Rooted in centuries of sacred craftsmanship, the brand carries forward the divine artistry found in temple sculptures, rituals, and celestial motifs.    Every jewel is created with devotion - slow, deliberate, mindful. Skilled artisans treat each piece like a prayer, shaping metal and stones with the reverence once reserved for deities. The result is jewellery that radiates not just beauty, but blessings. And when a woman wears Nakshatra Mandir, she doesn't just accessorize - she carries grace, heritage, and the gentle light of the divine.
data.tagline: Crafted in devotion, worn with grace.

data.description:
"Ethnika House stands at the intersection of heritage and modernity. Inspired by India’s rich tapestry of regional artforms, the brand unites classical motifs with contemporary aesthetics - creating jewellery that feels both timeless and relevant.

From meenakari to filigree, from temple motifs to tribal patterns, each creation echoes a cultural story. Yet, every design is refined for the modern woman - versatile, lightweight, and fashion-forward.

Ethnika House is where tradition doesn’t remain in the past… it walks confidently into the present, and shines into the future. "

Born from the wild heart of India’s wandering tribes, Boho Banjara celebrates the freedom to be exactly who you are - unedited, unrestrained, and unafraid.

Every piece carries the marks of the hands that shaped it: raw textures, imperfect edges, rebellious silhouettes. This isn’t jewellery refined into silence; it’s jewellery that speaks, that laughs loudly, that refuses to fit in.

Boho Banjara is for the rule-breakers, the dream-chasers, the ones who colour outside the lines.
Because true beauty doesn’t hide behind polish. It shows up unfiltered - and unapologetic.

At RangAuraa, colour is more than a design choice - it is a language. A flame-red ruby for passion. A serene blue topaz for calm. A joyful citrine for optimism. The brand celebrates the kaleidoscope of personalities, moods, and emotions that make each woman unique.

Every gemstone is chosen for its natural energy and expressive power, then set in contemporary designs that let the colour speak boldly.

RangAuraa invites you to adorn not just your outfit, but your identity - to wear the spectrum of YOU.

Kaamya Jewels, a brand defined by a 25-year legacy in the world of fine jewelry. Kaamya specializes in bespoke creations that bridge the gap between traditional craftsmanship and modern artistic vision. Known for their meticulous sourcing of rare gemstones and a commitment to exceptional craftsmanship, every piece they produce is a unique narrative in gold and stone. They are renowed for  jewelry that is as distinctly artistic as it is masterfully made, Kaamya Jewels represents the pinnacle of personalized luxury."

Established in 1960, Bhaiyalal Basant Kumar Saraf (BBS Jewellers) has been a trusted name in fine jewellery, built on a legacy of integrity, craftsmanship, and customer satisfaction. At BBS Jewellers, we specialize in BIS hallmarked gold jewellery, ensuring every piece meets the highest standards of purity and authenticity. Our carefully curated collections combine traditional artistry with contemporary designs, making them perfect for every occasion—from weddings and celebrations to everyday elegance. We also provide IGI/GIA-certified natural diamonds, giving our customers complete confidence in the quality, brilliance, and value of every diamond they purchase. Understanding that every customer has a unique vision, we offer customized jewellery designing and manufacturing services. At the heart of BBS Jewellers lies an unwavering commitment to purity, transparency, fair pricing, and personalized service. Every creation is a symbol of trust that has been passed down through generations.
At Gahana Shree Jewels, we have been earning our customers' trust since 2013 by offering quality gold and silver jewellery at fair prices.

Alankar Jewellers, Raisen is a trusted destination for exquisite gold, silver, diamond, and bridal jewellery. We are committed to offering certified purity, elegant designs, transparent pricing, and warm customer service. Our mission is to make every celebration memorable by providing jewellery that combines timeless craftsmanship with lasting value.

Classy Cut is an Indian fine jewellery brand specializing in handcrafted, made-to-order jewellery designed around each customer's unique vision. Built on generations of expertise in the jewellery industry, we combine traditional craftsmanship with modern design to create timeless pieces that celebrate life's most meaningful moments.

Our Legacy – Jagdamba Pearls Hyderabad’s Heritage Brand A Century of Heritage, Trust, and Timeless Jewelry From Hyderabad’s original pearl pioneer to India’s most trusted pearl and jewelry destination, Jagdamba Pearls’ legacy is a story of craftsmanship, authenticity, and timeless elegance. Founded in 1924 during Hyderabad’s Nizam era, Jagdamba Pearls is one of the few jewelry houses with a direct lineage to the city’s royal pearl trade. While others speak of heritage, ours is documented — a century of authentic craftsmanship and heirloom-quality pearls trusted by generations. The Origin – A Brand Born of Vision and the Jagdamba Pearls Legacy Centuries ago, long before Hyderabad became a metropolis, caravans carried spices and silks through its arid plains. But it was the shimmering pearls — born of faraway oceans — that gave the city its soul. Traders from the Persian Gulf arrived with satchels of Basra pearls, their iridescent glow catching the eyes of the Nizams and their royal court. In candlelit workshops, skilled artisans bent over simple wooden benches, drilling, bleaching, and stringing pearls into seven-strand Satlada necklaces — pieces that became symbols of prestige and grace. Under royal patronage, Hyderabad transformed into the City of Pearls, a place where wealth was not just counted in gold but weighed in ropes of white, pink, and golden pearls.

KuberBox is a direct-to-consumer fine jewellery brand founded in 2013 and headquartered in Jaipur, India's gemstone capital. For over a decade, we have designed and manufactured certified natural diamond and BIS-hallmarked gold jewellery for customers who want the real thing — without the markups, the pressure, or the intimidation of a traditional jewellery showroom.

About Sanmati Jewellers

 

Since 1993, Sanmati Jewellers has been built on a simple promise of purity, craftsmanship, and trust. 

 

For over 33 years, we have been part of our customers' most cherished moments, creating jewellery that reflects both tradition and quality.

 

Today, that same legacy continues with a modern touch. Our hallmarked gold and sterling silver collections blend timeless craftsmanship with contemporary design, offering pieces made for everyday elegance as well as life's special occasions.

Marka Jewelry is a Jaipur-based manufacturer and exporter of premium sterling silver jewelry, natural gemstones, and handcrafted gemstone jewelry. With years of experience in gemstone craftsmanship, we specialize in creating high-quality jewelry that combines timeless elegance with exceptional workmanship. Our collections include gemstone rings, earrings, pendants, bracelets, necklaces, and custom jewelry designed for customers worldwide. We are committed to ethical sourcing, superior quality, competitive pricing, and customer satisfaction, making us a trusted partner for retailers, wholesalers, and jewelry brands across international markets.

"A Legacy of Trust, Elegance, and Flawless Craftsmanship
Established in 2004, Sheetla Jewellers has spent over two decades redefining luxury and building lasting relationships. Celebrating a landmark journey from 2004 to 2026, we have proudly grown into the most trusted and celebrated jewelry showroom in the entire district.
For over 22 years, our name has been synonymous with purity, transparent dealings, and breathtaking designs that turn your milestones into golden memories.
Why Our Patrons Choose Us:
Two Decades of Unmatched Trust: As the premier showroom in the district, we have earned the generational loyalty of families who rely on us for their most precious celebrations.
Purity Guaranteed: Every piece of jewelry at Sheetla Jewellers is a testament to strict quality standards and certified authenticity.
Heritage Meets Modernity: Our extensive collections seamlessly blend timeless, traditional heritage jewelry with contemporary, high-fashion modern designs.
A Personalized Experience: We don’t just sell jewelry; we craft experiences. Our showroom offers a warm, luxurious environment where every customer is treated like family.
From exquisite bridal sets that honor tradition to minimalist daily wear that celebrates modern elegance, Shitala Jewellers remains your ultimate destination for timeless luxury.
Sheetla Jewellers — Crafting Trust, Wearing Elegance Since 2004."
